This role owns leena.ai website end-to-end: shipping website changes, standing up A/B testing, and driving conversion optimization. Document experimentation standards (sample size, run time, success metrics) for the team.

Analyze conversion data by page, traffic source, geography, and device to identify drop-off points.

Run iterative experiments on headlines, hero sections, social proof, form fields, and CTA placement to improve demo-request conversion rate.

Partner with the Marketing teams to close the loop from website lead to qualified pipeline, feeding learnings back into page design.

Own the Leena sandbox experience reduce setup friction, improve time-to-value.

Build and iterate on a product wedge: a self-serve tool on leena.ai (e.g., HR ticket analyzer, automation ROI calculator) that uses Leenas domain model to deliver value a general-purpose LLM cant replicate.

Instrument the wedge funnel; signups, activation, engagement, PQL conversion.

Work with Product to define what "product-qualified" means and how wedge usage maps to enterprise buying intent.

Strong proficiency in React and Next.js (SSR, SSG, API routes, image optimization).

Solid HTML/CSS fundamentals; responsive layouts, accessibility (WCAG 2.1), cross-browser compatibility.

Experience with at least one A/B testing or feature-flagging tool (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, VWO, or custom).
